knubs.definition:
n. pl. Waste silk formed in winding off the threads from a
   cocoon.

knuckle.definition:
n. a joint of a finger when the fist is closed
v. press or rub with the knuckles
v. shoot a marble while keeping one's knuckles on the ground
knuckle.translation:
n. 指节, 蹄爪, 膝关节
v. 以指节打, 以手指射

knuckle arm.translation: [机] 转向节臂, 羊角臂

knuckle down.translation: 开始认真工作, 屈服

knuckle duster.translation:
na. 指关节保护套
[网络] 指节环套；钢铁拳套；格斗臂套

knuckle joint.translation: [计] 铰链连接, 肘形接

knuckle-bones.translation: (knuckle-bone 的复数) n. 膝节骨；指关节骨

knuckle-dusters.translation: n. 指节铜套（一种打架时用的凶器）; 指节铜套（一种可以伤人的武器）( knuckle-duster的复数形式 )

knuckleball.definition: n. a baseball pitch thrown with little speed or spin
knuckleball.translation: n. [棒](投手投出的)不旋转球

knucklebones.translation: (knucklebone 的复数) n. 指关节骨, 骨

knuckled.definition:
imp. & p. p. of Knuckle
a. Jointed.
knuckled.translation: v. （指人）指关节( knuckle的过去式和过去分词 ); （指动物）膝关节, 踝

knucklehead.definition: n a stupid person; these words are used to express a low opinion of someone's intelligence

knuckleheads.definition: n. a stupid person; these words are used to express a low opinion of someone's intelligence

knuckler.definition: n a baseball pitch thrown with little speed or spin
knuckler.translation: n. (=knuckle ball)[棒球] 慢速变化球

knuckles.definition:
n a small metal weapon; worn over the knuckles on the back of the hand
n a joint of a finger when the fist is closed
v press or rub with the knuckles
v shoot a marble while keeping one's knuckles on the ground
knuckles.translation:
n. （指人）指关节( knuckle的名词复数 ); （指动物）膝关节, 踝
v. （指人）指关节( knuckle的第三人称单数 ); （指动物）膝关节, 踝

knuckling.definition:
v press or rub with the knuckles
v shoot a marble while keeping one's knuckles on the ground

knudsen.translation: n. 努森（M·H·C, 1871-1949, 丹麦物理学家）

knur.translation: n. 硬节, 瘤, 木球

knurl.definition:
n. A contorted knot in wood; a crossgrained protuberance; a
   nodule; a boss or projection.
n. One who, or that which, is crossgrained.
v. t. To provide with ridges, to assist the grasp, as in the
   edge of a flat knob, or coin; to mill.
knurl.translation: n. 木节, 木瘤, 隆起

knurled.definition:
a. Full of knots; gnarled.
a. Milled, as the head of a screw, or the edge of a coin.
knurled.translation: a. 有节的, 有凸边的

knurling.translation:
n. 滚花
[计] 压花, 滚花, 刻痕

knurly.definition:
superl. Full of knots; hard; tough; hence, capable of enduring
   or resisting much.
knurly.translation: a. 多瘤的, 多节的

knurr.translation: n. 硬节, 瘤, 木球

knust.translation: abbr. Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology 瓜米鲁玛科技大学

knut.definition: n king of Denmark and Norway who forced Edmund II to divide England with him; on the death of Edmund II, Canute became king of all England (994-1035)
knut.translation: n. (=Canute) 花花公子, 纨裤子弟

knut hamsun.translation: [网络] 汉姆生；哈姆生；克努特汉姆生
